scope: Repeated physical run lifecycle after the UCSB-XRP 0.3 API provision
motion: No physical motion requested; the lifecycle project retained a zero drive command.

passedBeforeFailure: IDE and Monitor discovered the same retained project
new-file edit, stale-revision propagation, and resynchronization
reproduction.failure: The second IDE-started /run request did not reply within 8 seconds. HTTP and the USB REPL then remained unresponsive while ICMP and USB identity initially remained present.

diagnosis.classification: boundary localized; exact VM lock owner not observable after the hard hang
diagnosis.evidence: The post-stop boot, edit, flash synchronization, and retained revision all completed. The next run command entered the installed synchronous core-1 startup boundary and never returned.
diagnosis.risk: RP2350 MicroPython shares its VM, allocator, and flash coordination across the service and student cores; a lockup in this boundary previously required a physical reset.

changes: Compile and prepare the entrypoint on service core 0.
Return the run response in loading state before scheduling core-1 launch.
Finish any in-flight browser telemetry request and leave a 500 ms startup quiet interval.
Feed a 7 s RP2350 hardware watchdog from the service event loop so a VM-level deadlock automatically reboots.
Bound macOS serial-device open to 2 s so a frozen USB driver cannot hang the instructor recovery harness.

recovery.targetedUsbReset: The exact VID/PID link reset and re-enumeration completed on macOS, but the frozen controller could not reattach. This distinguished a controller hang from a host-driver-only failure.
recovery.pending: Press RESET once, install the corrected service, then repeat the strict service probe and two-run Stable Chrome lifecycle.

result: correction software-validated; physical install and repetition pending one controller reset
